onboarding.welcomeIntro: RFM Tray sends finished catalogs to RFM for you, so you no longer click "Send" in RFM for every folder.
onboarding.welcomeHow:
How it works:
1. You copy or move a finished product folder into {folder}.
2. RFM Tray waits until copying has finished and nothing in the folder has changed for {seconds} s.
3. It sends the folder to RFM in your name – exactly like the "Send" button. RFM checks the name and the photos.
4. The sent folder leaves your folder and a "Sent to RFM" notification appears.
onboarding.welcomeProblems: If something is wrong (a name RFM does not know, too few photos, the catalog is already in RFM, no connection), the folder stays where it is and RFM Tray shows a notification explaining what to do.
onboarding.welcomeIcon: The RFM Tray icon sits next to the clock (sometimes under the ^ arrow). Click it to see what is happening to each folder. An icon with an exclamation mark means something needs you – the top of the window says what and how to fix it.
onboarding.welcomeSteps: This takes a minute: you sign in, choose your folder, and at the end RFM Tray checks with the RFM server that everything works.
onboarding.signInText: RFM Tray sends folders in your name, so it must be signed in to RFM. You sign in once, in the browser, with your usual RFM login.
onboarding.signInHint: The browser opens when you click. Approve the sign-in there and come back to this window – RFM Tray notices by itself.
onboarding.signInWaiting: The browser has opened. Approve the RFM sign-in and come back here…
onboarding.signedIn: ✔ Signed in as {user} – confirmed by RFM.
onboarding.notSignedIn: Not signed in. Click the button below.
onboarding.signInError:
✖ Cannot connect to RFM ({url}): {error}
Check the connection to the company network and try again.
onboarding.folderText: Choose the folder you will drop finished catalogs into – usually your folder in DO KATALOGU. Every folder dropped inside will be sent to RFM.
onboarding.folderWarning: Choose only your own folder: everything sent from it is recorded in RFM under your name.
onboarding.checkText: RFM Tray now checks with the RFM server everything it needs to send: the connection, the sign-in and your folder.
onboarding.whatNext: What next: drop a finished catalog into {folder}. About {seconds} s after copying ends it leaves the folder, and RFM Tray confirms the first send with a "RFM Tray works!" notification.
